subject: FintechCo security questionnaire — CAIQ/SIG deliverables & clarifying Qs
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha@fintechco.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-28T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: FintechCo security questionnaire — CAIQ/SIG deliverables & clarifying Qs

Hi Asha — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we’re all aligned: 

Call recap (brief):
- Scope: FintechCo evaluation of Redwood for customer-facing data pipeline (payments/KYC).
- Key asks you called out: SOC 2 Type II evidence, encryption controls (at-rest/in-transit), and a vendor questionnaire (you suggested CAIQ may be preferred).

What we’ll deliver:
1) Pre-filled CAIQ spreadsheet (we’ll provide a Redwoods-first prefill to speed review).
2) High-level SOC 2 summary (scope & last report date) + auditor contact for consented sharing where needed.
3) Short encryption & data-residency note that lists regions we support and default KMS behavior.

Clarifying questions we need from you to ensure the right artifacts:
- Is FintechCo’s assessment limited to non-PHI financial data, or will PHI/medical data be in-scope? (affects HIPAA controls)
- Do you need a SOC 2 Type II full report, or is a SOC 2 summary + bridge letter sufficient initially?
- Preferred questionnaire: CAIQ (Audit/Cloud) vs. SIG Lite vs. your internal custom form? If custom, can you attach the form?
- Data residency: must data remain in US regions only? Any EU residency/GDPR-specific requirements?

Timeline proposal: we can deliver the CAIQ prefill + SOC2 summary by 2026-04-06 if we have answers to the above and the security contact who will review. Would that timeline work?

Attachments I’m sending with this note: redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf (summary), redwood_SIG-exec-instructions.pdf (what to expect if you request executed SIG docs).

Next steps: please confirm the preferred questionnaire and the security/legal contact at FintechCo (Paul? someone else?) and whether an NDA is needed before we share the auditor-consented SOC 2 report. If helpful, we can schedule a short (30m) technical deep-dive for next week — I’ve copied Sergio (security) to coordinate.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

---
Attachments referenced: redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf, redwood_SIG-exec-instructions.pdf
From: Asha Menon <asha@fintechco.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Paul Ryan <paul.ryan@fintechco.com>, security@fintechco.com
Date: 2026-03-28T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FintechCo security questionnaire — CAIQ/SIG deliverables & clarifying Qs

Hi Neha — appreciate the follow-up and tidy recap. Answers inline below and some clarifying points from our security team: 

- PHI: No PHI in scope. We process payment and identity verification data (KYC) but not medical records.
- SOC 2: We typically request the full SOC 2 Type II report for vendor risk teams; initially a summary is OK to start the security review, but our procurement/legal will request the full report before contract execution.
- Questionnaire preference: CAIQ is preferred because it maps better to our cloud controls inventory. If you can deliver a prefilled CAIQ that would be ideal.
- Data residency: US-only for production data; we may keep development/test in other regions but that’s not in-scope for vendor review.

Security contact for review: security@fintechco.com (this inbox is monitored by our security team; Paul Ryan in Legal is the contracting contact).

Timeline: if you can get the CAIQ prefill + SOC 2 summary to us within 10 business days that would be fine — ideally by 2026-04-09. We may have 1–2 follow-up clarifications after review.

A couple of follow-up Qs from our security engineers:
1) Does Redwood have an established HIPAA compliance program or BA agreements available? (we may not need it for this engagement but want to know the posture)
2) For encryption at-rest: do you use customer-managed keys (CMKs) or provider-managed keys by default? Is BYOK available?
3) Incident notification SLA: do you have a standard 72-hour for security incidents and RTO/RPO commitments?

If Sergio is available for a 30m deep-dive next week, please propose 2 slots and we’ll pick one.

Thanks — Asha
Asha Menon
Head of InfoSec, FintechCo
asha@fintechco.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha@fintechco.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Paul Ryan <paul.ryan@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-03-29T09:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FintechCo security questionnaire — CAIQ/SIG deliverables & clarifying Qs

Thanks Asha — that all makes sense. Quick answers / plan from our side: 

1) HIPAA/BAA: Redwood does maintain a HIPAA-ready posture and we can enter a BAA where the use case warrants. We don’t have a separate HIPAA certification but do have controls and contractual templates for BAAs.
2) Encryption/keys: default is provider-managed CMKs; BYOK (customer-managed keys) is supported for Dedicated/private deployments. I’ll include a short note explaining the behavior for Hosted vs Dedicated in the artifacts.
3) Incident notification: our standard security incident notification SLA is 72 hours for initial notification; we also provide a post-incident report and remediation timeline where applicable — I’ll include the incident response summary.

Plan & timeline: we’ll deliver the CAIQ prefill, SOC 2 summary, and a short encryption/residency note by 2026-04-06 (earlier than your 10-business-day target) assuming no blockers. If you require the full SOC 2 report we’ll share instructions to request auditor consent (see attached redwood_SIG-exec-instructions.pdf). 

Sergio will reach out to schedule the 30m technical deep-dive — Sergio, can you propose 2 slots (Tue/Wed next week)?

I’ve copied Priyom from Contracts to track any formal requests (NDA/PO/SOC2 consent) so we can move quickly.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
